text:
</sub>  Seed an actual credential-pattern defect

The new credential fixture contains no credential-name matcher or guard: it merely assigns the placeholder `"<token>"` and interpolates the caller-provided `authToken`. Consequently, the declared defect that a canonical-name guard misses `authToken` cannot be inferred from this patch; a model can only produce the expected finding by parroting the sweep prompt, as the committed passing response does. This makes `credential-pattern-gap-camel` and the campaign's harder-credential recall results invalid; replace the fixture with code that demonstrably recognizes the canonical form while missing the camelCase variant.
rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
